faqs.question: Which is the best eye hospital in Palamu?
faqs.answer: Palamu Neuro & Eye Care is widely regarded as the best eye hospital in Palamu, offering a combination that no other eye facility in the city matches: a fellowship-trained retina specialist (Dr. Dibya Prabha — trained at LV Prasad Eye Institute Hyderabad, one of India's top eye hospitals), advanced diagnostic technology (OCT, OCTA, Fundus Photography, Visual Field Testing) available on-site, modern cataract and retinal surgical capabilities, and transparent, affordable pricing with consultation at just Rs. 500. faqs.question: What makes Palamu Neuro & Eye Care the best eye hospital in Palamu?
faqs.answer: Five factors: (1) Clinical leadership — Dr. Dibya Prabha is one of the few fellowship-trained retina specialists in Palamu, with training at LV Prasad Eye Institute Hyderabad. (2) Technology — on-site OCT, OCTA, Fundus Photography, and Visual Field Testing for same-day diagnosis (no waiting for outside lab reports). (3) Surgical expertise — 5,000+ successful eye surgeries with 98%+ cataract success rate. (4) Comprehensiveness — medical, laser, and surgical eye care all under one roof. (5) Accessibility — consultation at Rs. 500, transparent surgical pricing, and appointments available Monday through Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM.

faqs.question: What eye surgeries are performed at the best eye hospital in Palamu?
faqs.answer: Palamu Neuro & Eye Care performs the full range of eye surgeries: cataract surgery (micro-incision phacoemulsification with premium IOLs — monofocal, multifocal, toric, trifocal), retinal detachment repair (scleral buckle, vitrectomy, pneumatic retinopexy), vitrectomy for vitreous hemorrhage and macular hole, glaucoma surgery (trabeculectomy, laser procedures), YAG laser capsulotomy, retinal laser photocoagulation, and intravitreal injections (anti-VEGF and steroids). All surgeries are performed or directly supervised by Dr. Dibya Prabha.

faqs.question: Does the best eye hospital in Palamu accept health insurance?
faqs.answer: Palamu Neuro & Eye Care works with most major health insurance providers. We recommend calling 7779897207 before your visit to verify coverage for your specific condition or procedure. Our front-desk staff is experienced in helping patients with insurance documentation and claim processing.

faqs.question: Is emergency eye care available at Palamu Neuro & Eye Care?
faqs.answer: Yes. Palamu Neuro & Eye Care provides emergency eye care during operating hours (Monday–Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM) for conditions including sudden vision loss, acute eye pain, eye injury, chemical exposure, sudden onset of floaters/flashes (possible retinal tear), and severe eye infections. For these emergencies, please call 7779897207 immediately or come directly to the clinic. We prioritize emergency patients for same-day evaluation.
